summary: Appeal against reduced conviction from Section 302 to 304(1) IPC; custodial death; police brutality claims; motive dispute; delay in complaint (June 10-21, 1992); failure to disclose injuries before magistrate; multiple injuries documented in postmortem; co-accused unharmed raises suspicion; appellant deceased during proceedings; LRs substituted per CrPC s.394; challenge to conviction based on inconsistency in prosecution narrative and evidentiary gaps;
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Section 304(1) conviction upheld; compensation of Rs.50,000 awarded to heirs; High Court judgment partially modified;
